name: liwan Platform
description: The composition baseline of the one liwan codebase, as it ships today. Each tier is a module composition label, not a commercial package: names, prices and numeric ceilings are pending decisions D16/D09/D11 and are deliberately absent. A limit feature is included by a tier with its ceiling left to the trusted operator, which matches the shipped default (an absent limit is unbounded).

tiers.name: Core
tiers.description: Base modules only: the platform, its capability catalog and the shared API.

tiers.name: Projects
tiers.description: Adds the project and meeting pillar over the base modules.

tiers.name: People
tiers.description: Adds the HR pillar over the base modules.

tiers.name: Messaging
tiers.description: Adds the member-private chat pillar over the base modules.
